name: Electrosteel Castings Ltd
about: Electrosteel Castings is engaged in the business of manufacturing Ductile Iron (DI) Pipes, Ductile Iron Fittings (DIF), Cast Iron (CI) Pipes and produces and supplies Pig Iron. [1][2]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Electrosteel Castings Limited manufactures and  sells Ductile Iron (DI) pipes, fittings, and related products, catering to water infrastructure projects in India and international markets.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.77 times its book value

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 12.4% over last 3 years.
